messages:
jana: Heads-up: increased gpu attach failures in us-west1 during last scale wave. Errors tied to a small cohort of hosts showing NVMe thermal throttles + reclaimer IO spikes.

omar: saw that too. gn-west-9 and gn-west-11 show sustained temp >75C and repeated controller slowdowns in logs. dmesg snippet:
```
[ 7654.123456] nvme nvme0: temperature above threshold, throttling
[ 7654.123789] blk_mq_dispatch: queue 0 stuck, inflight 96
[ 7654.124000] nvme nvme0: controller reset due to timeout
```

lucy: root cause looks like background reclaimer (ephemeral-reclaim) kicking heavy compaction during the scale-up window; combined with a fleet cooling hiccup. Reclaimer concurrency spiked to 30.

jana: mitigation: lowering reclaimer concurrency to 3 for us-west1, cordoning the hottest hosts, and adding attach-router blacklist for 40m.

kai: commands I'm running now:
```
# throttle reclaimer
kubectl -n ops patch configmap ephemeral-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/reclaim_concurrency","value":"3"}]'
# cordon hottest host
kubectl cordon gn-west-11 && kubectl drain gn-west-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

deploy-bot: attach-router: blacklisted hosts updated (us-west1: gn-west-9, gn-west-11) -> fallback us-west2 (canary, 40m).

omar: follow-ups: schedule SMART quick checks once temps normalize, check reallocated sectors and thermal event counters. If controllers show repeated reset count >10 in 24h, plan drive replacement.

lucy: ops runbook change: add 'backoff reclaimer during scale windows' and 'auto-detect thermal+io thrash to trigger attach reroute'. PR incoming.

jana: cost note: recommend 4% hot spare in west regions as buffer; cheaper than repeated attach retries and customer impact.

kai: status: cordoned 1/2 hosts, reclaimer concurrency patched, routing fallback live. attach error rate declining. Leaving thread open for SMART & temp-stable checks.
